def url_basename(url):
    if not url:
        return ''
    # The url may contain a scheme, so we need to split it to find the basename
    path = urlparse.urlsplit(url).path
    basename = path.strip('/')
    if not basename:
        return ''
    # We only want the final component of the path. It may be suffixed with
    # extra slash, so we split the final component by slash.
    return basename.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]
